fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: RESET
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: RESET_n asserted; channel in known state; mode registers undefined.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: INITIALIZATION
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Supply ramp, RESET_n deassertion, mode-register programming, ECC/RFM config, link training.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: BANK_ACTIVE
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: A row is open; column READ/WRITE allowed on the C bus.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: READING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Burst read; DRAM drives DQ + RDQS for the addressed pseudo-channel.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: WRITING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Burst write; controller drives DQ + WDQS for the addressed pseudo-channel.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: PRECHARGING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Open row being closed; bitlines restored.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: REFRESHING
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: REFRESH/RFM in progress; no column access during the window.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: Per-channel low-power; clock may be gated; fast exit.

fsm_states_dram_per_channel.name: SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_dram_per_channel.description: DRAM self-refreshes; channel clock may stop; exit re-synchronizes.

fsm_states_controller.name: PSEUDO_CHANNEL_ARBITER
fsm_states_controller.description: Arbitrates column commands between the two 32-bit pseudo-channels of a channel.

fsm_states_controller.name: REFRESH_MANAGER
fsm_states_controller.description: Tracks activate counts, issues RFM, adapts refresh to TEMP.

fsm_states_controller.name: ECC_RAS_HANDLER
fsm_states_controller.description: Processes link/on-die ECC reports, CA-parity alerts, initiates soft-repair.

fsm_hints.trigger: Each channel runs its own command stream; commands registered at rising CK_t/CK_c edges.
fsm_hints.rule: Row commands on the R bus, column commands on the C bus (per pseudo-channel); both can be active in one cycle.
fsm_hints.channel_independence: No cross-channel interlock: a command on channel N never changes channel M.
fsm_hints.abort: Stopping the channel clock during self-refresh/power-down halts the channel gracefully.

anti_deadlock_rule: Single controller masters all command/address; the DRAM is a target with no command-bus contention. Per-channel independence prevents one channel from blocking another. RFM is mandatory to prevent disturbance-induced data loss under sustained high activate rates.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-on, rails ramp (VDDC/VDDQ/VDDQL/VPP), RESET_n held LOW then deasserted; the controller programs mode registers (timing, ECC, RFM, pseudo-channel mode), trains links per channel, and brings each channel to IDLE before ACTIVATE.

default_ready_state_recommendation.CK_t_CK_c: Toggling differential clock per channel; may stop in self-refresh.
default_ready_state_recommendation.command_buses_R_C: Deselect/NOP when no command is issued.

configurations.name: Pseudo-channel mode
configurations.description: Two independent 32-bit column streams per 64-bit channel.

configurations.name: RFM-active high-throughput mode
configurations.description: Adaptive refresh under high activate rates.

timing_dependency_rule: Read data on a channel's DQ depends on its prior READ at read latency RL; write data acceptance depends on its prior WRITE at write latency WL. WDQS/RDQS windows must be met. There is no per-beat handshake; the host controller honours all per-channel timing and refresh-management constraints.
